prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE fresh individual landscape illustration, 3:2 aspect ratio, intended 1536 x 1024. This is art only for an adult editorial weather social campaign, no slide layout, typography or graphic design.
Subject: a curving MINIATURE BAY at blue hour, an olive felt headland on the RIGHT, calm indigo and deep teal water on the LEFT. The headland's gently curving shoreline creates an elegant asymmetrical crescent composition. SILVERY THIN RADIATION MIST lies directly on the INLAND GROUND in hollows on the right, a low delicate sheet only a tiny distance above the terrain, never a floating cloud over the sea. A small pale warm-ivory moon hangs in the upper left-center sky. The landscape is a sophisticated physical miniature diorama, subtly visible felt land strata along the shore, fine wool ground textures, gently sculpted satin/clay water with restrained fine ripples and a soft reflected moon path. No houses are necessary and no added buildings.
Style: polished mature tactile felt/wool/clay sculptural diorama, photographed with realistic miniature studio lighting. Soft silvery almost-translucent fine wool mist hugging the ground. Take ONLY refined textile texture and realistic photographic lighting cues from inspected wind-v1 and sounding-v1 style references; this is a completely new, distinct artwork and scene, not copied objects. Editorial romance, calm and quietly cinematic, not a children's illustration or repeated cloud icon composition.
Color and exposure: MUCH DARKER than pale pink and ivory daytime artworks. Dominant night blue, indigo and deep teal, muted olive #706936 headland in blue moonlight, pale moon #fff7ed, minute muted violet #743cdd undertones; at most a nearly imperceptible blush #ffe2ec near the horizon. Rich dark water and sky, visible tactile land detail without lifting the whole image to daylight. No bright pink studio backdrop. Night atmosphere, not sunset.
Composition: landscape 3:2, a moderately elevated three-quarter view so the bay's curve and the thin inland-ground mist can both be clearly read, with a low dark distant horizon and generous sky. Main crescent headland, its point, low mist, and pale moon all entirely in frame, IMPORTANT SUBJECTS between 16 and 82 percent of image height, so a modest centered 16:9 crop preserves the moon and main headland. Let only unimportant foreground sea extend off the bottom edge; leave generous space around headland point. It must feel like a miniature atmospheric world, not a factual coast photograph. One continuous scene, not a contact sheet.
Lighting: cool moonlit miniature studio lighting, silver rims on the mist and felt ridge, restrained deep shadows, tactile fibers and realistic subtle surface reflections. Atmospheric yet legible.
Constraints: no people, animals, logos, text, numbers, letters, labels, arrows, UI, screenshots, watermarks, frame, poster, social slide, contact sheet, day sky, large cumulus, cloud icon, lighthouse, or houses. No factual cloud photograph. One individual distinct artwork only.
Final material priority: the miniature's handcrafted construction MUST BE VISUALLY UNMISTAKABLE at normal viewing size. Thick fuzzy needle-felt olive hillside with readily visible short wool fibers, shore built from soft sculpted matte-clay stones, water made from smooth indigo satin-clay with sculpted ripples rather than documentary ocean detail. Expose a delicate layered felt edge along part of the shore. The pale moon is a small softly lit ivory clay disc in a simple dark blue studio sky. Do NOT render this as an actual landscape photograph. Keep convincing miniature studio lighting and the dark blue-hour palette, with quiet silver wool mist lying in inland hollows. Refined fine-art textile diorama, not cartoon or toy. Pull the camera back enough to show the main headland and crescent bay as a coherent miniature object with generous composition.

verification.copy_integrity_method: shasum -a 256 on generated source and destination
verification.visual_inspection_method: direct inspection of native ImageGen output
verification.visual_inspection: Dark indigo/teal crescent bay with olive textured headland on right, water on left, pale moon, and thin silver fibrous mist in inland hollows. Material treatment is more photographic and subtle than the two daytime illustrations; shoreline strata and woolly land/mist remain visible. Main bay, moon, and mist are center-crop safe. No visible writing, logos, people, or UI.
